title: Café com pimenta
creator: cafezura

items.note: a few whole peppercorns, lightly crushed

steps: Put the pepper directly on top of the ground coffee, before brewing.
Pour the water through so it passes through the coffee and pepper together.
The heat almost disappears, leaving a fresh, slightly warming finish and a softer bitterness.
notes: A traditional way of drinking coffee in Morocco and Ethiopia.
